headline: Bradesco BBI Cuts Azul Price Target on Fuel and FX Pressures
summary: Bradesco BBI lowered its price target for Azul shares from R$ 22 to R$ 11, maintaining a neutral rating due to higher fuel costs, unfavorable exchange rates, and financial sensitivity.
why: Azul is a major Brazilian airline. Airlines are highly sensitive to jet fuel prices and currency fluctuations against the US dollar, which directly impact operating margins and debt servicing.

impacts.name: Azul SA
impacts.why: Lower analyst price targets reflecting macroeconomic cost pressures can weigh on investor sentiment and near-term equity valuations.
